description: Extended message record. Superset of chat.bsky.convo.defs#messageView — adds kind, contentType, encryption support.

facets.description: Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc). Compatible with app.bsky.richtext.facet.

embed.description: Embedded record reference. Compatible with app.bsky.embed.record.

kind.description: etzhayyim extension: message kind (text, system, agent, etc.)

contentType.description: etzhayyim extension: MIME content type for rich payloads

encrypted.description: etzhayyim extension: whether this message is E2E encrypted via com.etzhayyim.signal
